# FitFlow Health

> Prescription weight loss telehealth: compounded semaglutide and tirzepatide, plus
> sermorelin, NAD+, MIC+B12, glutathione, and skincare. Doctor-supervised, 100% online,
> medication shipped direct to patients in the U.S.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://www.fitflowrx.com/): Overview of treatments and pricing.
- [Compounded Tirzepatide](https://www.fitflowrx.com/treatments/tirzepatide): $134/mo, same active ingredient as Mounjaro.
- [Compounded Semaglutide](https://www.fitflowrx.com/treatments/semaglutide): $99/mo, same active ingredient as Wegovy.
- [How It Works](https://www.fitflowrx.com/how-it-works): 4-step process from online visit to ongoing care.
- [About](https://www.fitflowrx.com/about): Company mission and GLP-1 science overview.
- [FAQ](https://www.fitflowrx.com/faq): Pricing, insurance, side effects, and process questions.

## Notes
All medications are compounded, not FDA-approved; statements have not been evaluated by the FDA.
